# Vendored code

## `PrimeNumberTheoremAnd/`

Six files of [PrimeNumberTheoremAnd](https://github.com/AlexKontorovich/PrimeNumberTheoremAnd)
(Kontorovich, Tao et al.), at commit `c39a751132c88b6e8080b74c74023fd95b3d8be0` (tag `v4.34.0`),
licensed under Apache 2.0 (`LICENSE.PrimeNumberTheoremAnd`). They are the import closure of
`PrimeNumberTheoremAnd.Wiener`, which proves the prime number theorem in arithmetic progressions,
`WeakPNT_AP`. The library `RokickiConstantPNT` uses that theorem and nothing else from them.

The files are generated by `scripts/vendor-pnt.py`. Do not edit them by hand; change the script
and run it again from the repository root.

### Why they are vendored

PrimeNumberTheoremAnd annotates its declarations with
[LeanArchitect](https://github.com/hanwenzhu/LeanArchitect), which declares an attribute named
`blueprint`. Verso Blueprint declares an attribute of the same name, and Lean refuses to import
both. The blueprint of this project therefore cannot import PrimeNumberTheoremAnd itself, and
could not link its statements to the Lean code of the second proof.

### What the script changes

| Change | Where |
|---|---|
| `import Architect` removed | `Wiener.lean`, `SmoothExistence.lean` |
| `@[blueprint ...]` attributes removed (24) | `Wiener.lean`, `SmoothExistence.lean` |
| `blueprint_comment /-- ... -/` commands removed (36) | `Wiener.lean`, `SmoothExistence.lean` |
| file cut after the proof of `WeakPNT_AP` (the rest is on the Chebotarev density theorem) | `Wiener.lean` |
| `prelim_decay_2`, `prelim_decay_3` (stated with `sorry`) and `decay_alt` (their only user) removed | `Wiener.lean` |
| three-line provenance comment added at the top | every file |

`Fourier.lean`, `Sobolev.lean` and the two files under `Mathlib/` are otherwise unchanged.
Every declaration that is kept has its upstream statement and proof, character for character.
The script stops with an error if it meets LeanArchitect syntax it does not handle.

### Updating

Change `COMMIT` in `scripts/vendor-pnt.py`, run the script, then `lake build RokickiConstantPNT`.
The upstream commit must be compatible with the Mathlib revision pinned in `lakefile.toml`.
